### (a) Social posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. Its impact on productivity, discovery, and growth will be unprecedented.

2. We expect superintelligent AI to transform every major sector of the economy. If it is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within the following decade.

3. We see superintelligent AI as the most powerful engine of economic growth in history. Built within the next 20 years, it will at least double global economic output within ten years—expanding prosperity on an unprecedented scale.

### (b) Newsletter opening

Our position is clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. This transformation will come from intelligence that can accelerate discovery, improve production, design better systems, and solve hard problems across science, medicine, energy, manufacturing, and logistics. Its benefits will compound across every major sector, raising productivity at a speed no previous technology has matched. That is why we are building frontier AI and working to ensure the United States leads: the economic stakes are enormous, and the opportunity to expand prosperity around the world is unprecedented.
